name: zen-cad
description: Assembly-first CAD contract, replacement, and constrained detail skills packaged for Codex installs.

interface.shortDescription: Assembly-first CAD contracts, source replacement, and constrained detail CAD.
interface.longDescription: Zen CAD packages CAD-native assembly contract workflows for mechanical design agents. It produces layout contracts, source-lock evidence for standard parts, replacement plans, constrained detail shape plans, proceed gates, review bundles, and downstream CAD handoffs without pretending to replace CAD kernels or engineering certification.
defaultPrompt: Create a CAD-native assembly contract for a compact belt-drive module.
Create source-lock evidence for a sourced STEP part.
Replace a layout proxy with a source-locked STEP while preserving locked facts.
Generate a constrained detail shape plan for a custom bracket.
